page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-64-lssd is an arm64-based virtual machine instance featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB of system memory. This configuration provides a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core. The instance does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

A primary feature of this server configuration is its integrated local storage subsystem, which consists of 14 local NVMe SSDs totaling 5637 GB of capacity. This high-capacity local storage is bundled directly with the instance, offering low-latency, high-throughput data access directly attached to the physical host.

Utilizing the arm64 architecture generally offers high resource density and power efficiency compared to traditional architectures, translating to qualitative cost advantages for multi-threaded workloads. The combination of 64 dedicated cores, a balanced memory footprint, and substantial local NVMe SSD capacity makes this instance suitable for storage-intensive applications, large-scale databases, containerized microservices, and general-purpose enterprise workloads requiring rapid local read and write operations.
